question.worked_solution:
In this case, the expression for $f(x)$ is a quotient $\frac{u(x)}{v(x)}$ with $u(x)=\operatorname{csch}⁡x$ and $v(x)=2{x}^{2}.$ 

Therefore, we apply the quotient rule as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & =\frac{{u}^{′}(x)\cdot v(x)-u(x)\cdot {v}^{′}(x)}{[v(x)]^{2}} \\  & =\frac{(\operatorname{csch}⁡x)^{′}\cdot 2{x}^{2}-\operatorname{csch}⁡x\cdot (2{x}^{2})^{′}}{(2{x}^{2})^{2}} \\  & =\frac{-2{x}^{2}\operatorname{csch}⁡x\operatorname{coth}⁡x-4x\operatorname{csch}⁡x}{4{x}^{4}} \\  & =-\frac{2x\operatorname{csch}⁡x(x\operatorname{coth}⁡x+2)}{4{x}^{4}} \\  & =-\frac{\operatorname{csch}⁡x(x\operatorname{coth}⁡x+2)}{2{x}^{3}}\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
